description: issue #679 (SP7): with `sprites` active, `tell`/`ask`/`each` are profile reserved words, so redefining any of them as a PROCEDURE raises `ol-reserved-word` (spec/turtles-and-sprites.md:154,179) — one diagnostic per `define`, each pointing at the procedure-name token with `namespace` `reserved`. Paired with reserved-procedures-without-sprites, which runs this exact source under Core alone and checks clean: together they prove the reserved-word rule is gated on the active profile, not unconditional. Before this slice the rule was a normative MUST with no fixture at all.

diagnostics.message: tell is already a reserved, so it can't be redefined here.
ask is already a reserved, so it can't be redefined here.
each is already a reserved, so it can't be redefined here.
